image.alt: A rocky hillside of natural sandstone rock shelters in Madhya Pradesh, overhangs and boulders visible along the cliff line.

hunt.alt: Red rock painting of stick-figure hunters with spears and bows surrounding wild horned animals, on a natural rock-wall surface.

dance.alt: Red rock painting of a group of figures dancing with linked arms, bodies leaning in one direction, on a rock-wall surface.

pigment.alt: A close view of deep red pigment powder and a lump of the same red-brown clay beside a painted rock surface.
